title: 第一卷 人生初见 第二十三章 冥海修行第一卷 人生初见 第二十四章 第二阶段
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
虚无之地，又被人们称作冥海，除了无处不在的恶念外，这里只剩一片死寂。
不知过了多久，这片死寂的沙地传来隆隆的响声，能够看到远处一座高耸的石门忽然出现。
长孙在石门的后面，赤裸着上身，虽然身子还略显单薄，但肌肉的轮廓已然清晰可见。
只见长孙双脚前后站立，右脚脚跟微微抬起，双手成拳，提至面颊处，肘关节弯曲贴近两肋，自然含胸，肩部自然放松微向前蜷缩，双眼平视前方。
只听“呵”的一声，长孙用力蹬地，双腿发力，扭腰，右手直拳，一气呵成，紧接着左手直拳。一拳一拳的砸在石门上，每一记直拳都使得方方正正。
“长孙小子，你这招式倒是使得有那么几分意思，但这力量差得也太远了，我在前面可一点都感觉不到啊。”无名也没有回头看长孙，但却将长孙的一招一式了解得清清楚楚。
“我说无名前辈，你这让我砸门是怎么个说法，我怎么感觉你这是包藏祸心呢。我看你是想让我给你把这门砸开了你好逃出去吧。”长孙停下来喘着粗气说道。
“放屁，就你那细胳膊细腿，我再给你一百年也没这本事。少说废话，休息够了，给我继续砸。”无名不留情面的讥讽道。
“等等，容我再问一句。无名前辈，你总该给晚辈个解释吧，你光说这样对我有利，我也知道前辈不会害我，但我知其然却不知其所以然，心里难免会有些痒痒。前辈便满足了晚辈这点好奇心吧。”长孙急忙问道。
“你小子手上功夫不怎么样，嘴皮子功夫练得倒是不错。先前跟你说了恶念潜伏在你的体内，如果不清除迟早会有大问题，现在让你砸门就如同炼器一般，通过反复的锤炼将你体内的杂质清除。并且你以为这门就是简单的石门么，有多少人一辈子妄想摸一下都不得，现在你还在抱怨我让你砸门，它的价值岂是你能想到的。”无名解释道。
“那这个石门是什么呢？这么厉害莫非是什么神器？”长孙听无名这么说，看着石门立马两眼放光。
“臭小子，做你该干的事，不该打听的不要乱打听。”看到长孙这副摸样无名就气不打一处来。
“是。”
长孙立马乖顺的砸起门来，一招一式更加认真卖力。
但没砸一会，长孙又停了下来，问道：“前辈，照你这么说，那我光砸门双臂的杂质倒是排出来了，那身体里的呢？你看我是不是还应该撞门？”
说着长孙还像前世的老爷爷老奶奶撞树一般，后背向门一下一下的撞了起来，嘴上还说着：“前…啊…辈…，你…啊…看…，就…啊…是…啊…这…样…”
因为撞门，长孙的声音都变得不连贯了。
无名看着长孙一下下撞门，气得咬牙切齿。
“你小子再用你这没发育健全的脑子怀疑我的决定，我就拿你的头撞门。”
“啊，前辈，你的意思是我的头也有恶念倾入，也需要撞门？”长孙停下来问道。

“噗…你给我砸，砸到我让你停下为止，再多说话我就把你的舌头割下来。”无名被长孙气得抓狂。
……
长孙也不知道自己砸了多久，但只要长孙认定的事，便不会打任何折扣的去完成。无名没有让他停下来，他便不会停。
冥海没有白天黑夜，长孙也不知道此刻是何时，但自从自己掉到冥海醒来之后，便没有再感觉饥饿，长孙猜想可能是恶念中蕴含能量的原因。
而此刻长孙竟然又感到饥饿，直到这时无名才让长孙停下来，然后让长孙爬到石门的顶部打坐，运功吸收周围恶念入体。
这次长孙没有再质疑无名的决定，二话不说便手脚并用的爬到石门顶上，盘膝而坐，没过一会便入定。
冥海绝对是一个打坐修行的圣地，死一般的沉寂让人轻易便能入定。
但是如果谁敢在冥海入定那一定是在找死，长孙此刻便是那个找死的人。
长孙入定后发现，在他的感知中周围的恶念与灵气完全不同。灵气在感知中就如同漫天的星光，明亮却不耀眼，而恶念就仿佛是一个个跳动的恶魔，危险并且不安分。
长孙仿佛置身地狱一般，周围全是跳动的恶魔，但长孙却异常平静，而后运转功法，周围的恶念顿时涌向长孙体内。
长孙再次感受到上次昏迷前的痛苦，但这次感受得更加清晰。
长孙可以感受到身体的每一个部位都在承受刀割般的疼痛，恶念想要将自己的身体撕裂，撕成灰烬。
正当长孙承受巨大疼痛濒临昏迷时，身下的石门忽然被唤醒，长孙体内的恶念全部被石门吸收，而长孙的身体开始快速的修复。
一边在破坏一边再修复，破坏和修复渐渐达到一个平衡，而长孙的身体也开始变得更加坚韧。
长孙感觉自己入定了很久，久到灵魂都要出窍了一般，这时无名忽然大声的“嘿”了一声，将长孙唤醒。
长孙没有急着起身，而是先观察了一下自己的身体，发现身体素质貌似提高了一大截，如此快的提升速度在外界几乎是不可能。
content_en:
The land of nothingness, also known as the Sea of ​​Hell, is a place of deathly silence except for the ubiquitous evil thoughts.
After an unknown amount of time, a rumbling sound came from this dead sand, and a towering stone gate could be seen suddenly appearing in the distance.
Changsun was behind the stone gate, with his upper body naked. Although his body was still a little thin, the outline of his muscles was clearly visible.
Changsun was seen standing with his feet forward and backward, the heel of his right foot slightly raised, his hands forming fists and raised to his cheeks, his elbows bent close to his ribs, his chest naturally held, his shoulders naturally relaxed and slightly curled forward, and his eyes looking straight ahead.
Hearing a "heh" sound, Changsun pushed hard on the ground, exerted force with his legs, twisted his waist, and punched straight with his right hand, all in one go, followed by a straight punch with his left hand. Punch after punch hit the stone door, and each straight punch made the square square.
"Boy Changsun, this move of yours is somewhat interesting, but the power is too far behind. I can't feel it at all from the front." Wuming did not look back at Changsun, but he clearly understood Changsun's every move.
"Senior Wuming, what do you mean by asking me to break down the door? Why do I feel like you are harboring evil intentions? I think you want me to break down the door so you can escape." Changsun stopped and gasped.
"Fart, with your thin arms and legs, I won't be able to do this even if I give you another hundred years. Stop talking nonsense, get enough rest, and keep smashing it." Wuming sneered mercilessly.
"Wait, let me ask again. Senior Wuming, you should give this junior an explanation. You just said that this is good for me. I also know that senior will not harm me, but I know it but don't know why. It is inevitable that I will feel a little itchy in my heart. Senior will satisfy this junior's curiosity." The eldest grandson asked hurriedly.
"You're not very good at martial arts, but you're pretty good at talking. I told you before that evil thoughts are lurking in your body, and if you don't remove them, there will be big problems sooner or later. Now asking you to break the door is like making a weapon, and the impurities in your body will be removed through repeated tempering. And do you think this door is a simple stone door? How many people have been dreaming of touching it all their lives, and now you are still complaining that I let you break the door. You can't imagine its value." Wuming explained.
"Then what is this Shimen? Could it be such a powerful divine weapon?" Changsun heard Wuming say this, and his eyes immediately lit up when he looked at the Shimen.
"You brat, do what you're supposed to do, and don't pry around things you shouldn't." Seeing Changsun's nameless appearance, he became furious.
"Yes."
The eldest grandson immediately smashed the door obediently, working harder and harder with each move.
But after a while, the eldest grandson stopped again and asked: "Senior, according to what you said, the impurities in my arms were discharged when I just smashed the door, but what about the ones in my body? Do you think I should still hit the door?"
As he spoke, the eldest grandson was still like the grandparents in the previous life hitting a tree. He hit his back against the door again and again, and said: "Senior... ah... senior..., you... ah... look..., it's... ah... it's... ah... this... like..."
Changsun's voice became incoherent because he hit the door.
Wuming gritted his teeth in anger as he watched his eldest grandson banging on the door.
"You kid, if you use your immature brain to question my decision again, I will bang your head against the door."
"Ah, senior, do you mean that I also have evil thoughts in my head and need to hit the door?" Changsun stopped and asked.
"Pfft... you hit me until I tell you to stop. If you talk any more, I'll cut out your tongue." Wuming was driven crazy by his grandson.
…
The eldest grandson didn't know how long he had been working on it, but as long as the eldest grandson decided to do something, he would not compromise on it. If Wuming didn't ask him to stop, he wouldn't stop.
There is no day or night in the Minghai, and Zhangsun doesn’t know what time it is at this moment, but since he fell into the Minghai and woke up, he no longer feels anything.Hunger, Zhangsun guessed, might be the reason why evil thoughts contained energy.
But at this moment, the eldest grandson felt hungry again. It was only then that Wuming asked the eldest grandson to stop, and then asked the eldest grandson to climb to the top of the stone gate and meditate, using his energy to absorb the surrounding evil thoughts into his body.
This time, Changsun did not question Wuming's decision. Without saying a word, he climbed to the top of the stone gate on his hands and knees, sat cross-legged, and fell into meditation after a while.
Minghai is definitely a holy place for meditation and practice. The deathly silence makes it easy for people to enter meditation.
But anyone who dares to enter samadhi in the underworld must be seeking death, and Changsun is the one seeking death at this moment.
After Changsun entered samadhi, he discovered that the evil thoughts and aura around him were completely different from what he perceived. In perception, spiritual energy is like the starlight in the sky, bright but not dazzling, while evil thoughts are like beating demons, dangerous and restless.
The eldest grandson seemed to be in hell, surrounded by beating demons, but the eldest grandson was unusually calm, and then he started to use his kung fu, and the evil thoughts around him suddenly surged into the eldest grandson's body.
Changsun once again felt the pain before his last coma, but this time he felt it more clearly.
Changsun could feel that every part of his body was suffering from knife-like pain, and his evil thoughts wanted to tear his body apart and turn it into ashes.
Just when the grandson was suffering from huge pain and on the verge of coma, the Shimen beneath him was suddenly awakened. All the evil thoughts in the grandson's body were absorbed by the Shimen, and the grandson's body began to repair quickly.
While destroying and repairing at the same time, the destruction and repair gradually reached a balance, and Changsun's body began to become stronger.
Changsun felt that he had been in trance for a long time, so long that his soul was about to leave his body. At this time, Wuming suddenly said "Hey" loudly, waking Changsun up.
Changsun did not get up in a hurry, but first observed his body and found that his physical fitness seemed to have improved a lot. Such a rapid improvement was almost impossible in the outside world.
